scope: Official Google Merchant Help only; no account/UI/API/credential access; preliminary canonical review unchanged.

sources.title: Managing and editing your products
sources.supports: For an existing source, add/remove products in its original file and update that same source; Merchant Center reflects the source changes.

sources.title: Manage products in your Merchant Center account
sources.supports: For file-based removal, remove products from the file and resubmit. After account removal, disappearance from ads/free listings may take24-48hours. This does not specify source-header convergence time or prove removal occurred.

sources.title: Create a product data source
sources.supports: Primary sources can add/remove products; supplemental sources cannot add/remove products and only supply additional or replacement attributes.

sources.title: How to fix: Not submitted due to product limit
sources.supports: For API-supplied items, stopping uploads does not immediately free quota; explicit delete is the documented API mechanism. This API rule must not be applied as a need for deletion after a successful full file replacement.

sources.title: Check product visibility and status in Merchant Center
sources.supports: Processing product updates may take up to15minutes, usually after product edits. This is not an SLA for file omissions or source/list header totals.

sources.title: Viewing and understanding your product data
sources.supports: Total products includes products provided by the merchant and additional products found by Google; source and exact product identity must be distinguished when reconciling totals.

sources.title: Add products automatically from your online store
sources.supports: Found by Google is separately managed and website-derived information may remain in organic search; a full US file update is not proof of account-wide or organic removal.
